philosophy: Motion must earn its place: animate only when it adds purpose (feedback, spatial continuity, orientation), keep it fast (mostly under 300ms) with strong custom ease-out curves or springs, and never block the user. Interactions should be interruptible and gesture-driven (velocity-aware drags, momentum, rubber-banding), animate only transform/opacity for performance, respect reduced-motion, and sweat invisible details so components feel native and opinionated rather than configurable.
